response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine developer-tooling interest (LabWindows/CVI IDE components, test runners, MCP code generators), but the role's core stack is largely absent: Java is only peripheral in his history, and there is no evidence of Kotlin, Spring, or deep JVM expertise. His strongest recent work is TypeScript/Node.js product engineering and DLang systems work, which doesn't align with an enterprise JVM tooling role.
strengths: Direct IDE development experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong developer-tooling track record (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/dev-infra, MCP generators)
Broad senior experience across high-throughput, low-latency, and full-stack systems
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring ecosystem experience
Java is minor and dated in his work history; no deep JVM expertise shown
Recent focus (TypeScript/Node.js/AI tooling) diverges from enterprise JVM frameworks and app servers
